Title: Gul'dan Hotfix Patch #1
Subtitle: Bug Fixes
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Sustained Carapace Talent's simple tooltip now properly indicates that the Talent increases the Shield amount.

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Bonus Globe of Annihilation damage earned via Taste for Blood can now properly stack up to a maximum of 500 damage, rather than 250.

=== Heroes: Greymane ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Go for the Throat's cooldown to be permanently reduced to 60 seconds.

=== Heroes: Leoric ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Healing and damage done by a Drain Hope effect that is applied by the Death March Talent is now consistent with a standard Drain Hope cast.

=== Heroes: Lt. Morales ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Inoculation Talent now properly increases Safeguard's Damage Reduction to 50% for the first 1.5 seconds of the Ability's duration.

=== Heroes: Raynor ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Heroic Ability cooldowns will now be properly reduced when a Hero is killed after learning the A Card to Play Talent.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Learning the Blood and Thunder and Hunger of the Wolf Talents will no longer cause Basic Ability cooldowns to be reduced by 4 seconds, rather than 2 seconds, when attacking in Ghost Wolf form.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Enemies caught within Devouring Maw's area of effect will now be properly pulled inside of the Maw.
  • Nydus Network's detailed tooltip now properly lists the maximum number of Nydus Worms that can be active at any given time.
